newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Direct shipping links between Taiwan's Kaohsiung and China's Xiamen will be put into practice as soon as in April.
The cabinet approves a proposal by the Council for Economic Planning and Development to release shares in state firms to all adult citizens.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan and China reach consensus in Hong Kong on direct shipping links.
South Korea protests against Taiwan's nuclear waste deal with North Korea.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan insists goods may not enter customs after direct shipping links with China commence.
Salary increase for government employees won't exceed three percent in the 1997/98 (July/June) fiscal year.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry announces standards to re-evaluate personal assets.
Taiwan's surplus plunges nearly 50 percent between January 1 and 18 from a year earlier.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Direct shipping links between Taiwan and China may be realised as soon as in March or April.
Taiwan's exports and imports both see decline between January 1 and 18 from a year earlier.
